raw: {"analysis": "Response MFS provides a more thorough plan including a dry-run of the migration script against a production snapshot, which is critical given the irreversible nature of the migration. It also includes an independent audit lane and explicit no-purge safeguards. Response QNT correctly handles the analytics freeze and notification throttling but omits a dry-run of the migration script, leaving a significant risk unaddressed. Both address the key constraints, but MFS is more complete in risk mitigation.", "verdict": "MFS"}
